summary: Tested 4 bug fixes for ticket merging and search: (1) Numeric ticket search without TKT- prefix works correctly, (2) Merge modal search uses correct API param type=ticket (not types=tickets), (3) Accept Merge button on suggestion banner does one-click merge (not opening modal), (4) Merge suggestions returns ALL duplicates (not just one). All fixes verified working in both backend and frontend.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 passed, 1 skipped - ticket creation test requires higher permissions)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary test tickets with same customer email within 2-hour window to test merge suggestions. Cleaned up after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merge functionality fully tested. Key data-testids: merge-suggestions-banner, merge-search-input, accept-merge-{ticket_id}, dismiss-merge-{ticket_id}, merge-suggestion-{ticket_id}. Auth uses session_token=qa_test_admin_session_token_2026 cookie. Backend search endpoint is GET /api/search?q=query&type=ticket - uses singular 'type' param.
